source_title: Global Farmer Insights 2026: A closer look at Europe
data_period: Survey April–July 2026; spending intentions next 12–18 months
figure_ref: Exhibit 2 reported national net spending sentiment (editorial reconstruction)
business_context: Agri-input suppliers tailoring commercial strategy for farmers in Spain, Germany, and France under margin pressure.
key_message: 향후 12~18개월 농업 지출 순증가 의향은 스페인 +78%p, 독일 +44%p, 프랑스 −8%p로, 유럽 단일 영업 전략보다 국가별 투입재·장비 수요 세분화가 중요하다.
original_chart_type: Exhibit 2 graphic; original visual encoding inaccessible/unverified

encoding.x: reported value, percentage points for net sentiment; percentage for banking shares
encoding.axis: 0 reference line; no truncated x origin

data_spec.denominator: Percent of country survey respondents expecting to increase spending minus percent expecting to decrease (not share of all farmers increasing spending)
data_spec.time_basis: Survey April–July 2026; spending intentions next 12–18 months
data_spec.comparison: Three countries, same 2026 wave; different sample sizes 200/250/251; net difference in percentage points.
data_spec.sample: 701 Europe farmers: Germany n=250, France n=251, Spain n=200; total global 5,500 across 10 countries.

data_recipe: Use country × respondent spending outlook (increase/same/decrease); preserve sample design and missingness.
For each country calculate 100 × increase respondents / valid answers minus 100 × decrease respondents / valid answers.
Keep sign and percentage-point unit; do not interpret net result as respondents increasing spending.
Sort country values; draw diverging bars with anchored zero; use direct labels, note survey wave and projection horizon.
message_conditions: Values are net sentiment (difference in two proportions), not percentages of farmers who will spend more.
Country samples vary (ES200, DE250, FR251); no raw respondent data, confidence intervals, or weights published.
2026 expectation horizon 12–18 months is not realized spending; extreme events after field dates excluded.
design_moves: Use shared zero reference to emphasize France below neutral.
Highlight negative sign via separate thematic color.
Sort by score, label +/− signs with pp, show context and sample information.
diff_notes: Published article numbers checked; original exhibit visually not verified; editorial redesign rather than original reproduction.

training_pair.instruction: Render a diverging survey net-sentiment chart for Spain +78pp, Germany +44pp and France −8pp, with explicit signed units and 2026 survey fieldwork information.

run_commands: python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png
python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme neutral --output neutral.png
response.script: chart.py in this immutable bundle; execute with pandas/matplotlib; input fields explicitly mapped in CONTEXT
